info.name: Printer Settings (Core)
info.description:
Thermal printer configuration management stored in tenant.settings.printers JSONB.

Supports:
- Receipt printers (58mm, 80mm)
- Kitchen printers
- Label printers
- Network, USB, Bluetooth, Serial connections
- Network scanning for auto-discovery
- ESC/POS protocol support

**Feature Gate**: `printing.thermalPrinting` (Professional/Enterprise only)

**Base URL**: Set in environment variable `{{base_url}}`
**Authentication**: JWT token in `{{jwt_token}}`

request.description:
Get single printer configuration by ID.

**Permissions**: `read:PrinterSettings`
**Feature**: `printing.thermalPrinting`

Create new printer configuration.

**Required fields**:
- `name`: Printer display name
- `connectionType`: network, usb, bluetooth, serial
- `ipAddress`: Required for network printers

**Optional fields**:
- `printerType`: receipt (default), kitchen, label, invoice, report
- `port`: Network port (default: 9100)
- `model`: Printer model
- `manufacturer`: Printer manufacturer
- `paperSize`: 58mm, 80mm (default), A4
- `isActive`: true (default), false
- `isDefault`: false (default), true
- `receiptTemplate`: Custom template settings (JSONB)

**Permissions**: `create:PrinterSettings`
**Feature**: `printing.thermalPrinting`

Create kitchen printer for restaurant orders.

**Kitchen Printer Features**:
- Large text for kitchen staff visibility
- Order item grouping
- Time stamp on each order
- Order status tracking

Update printer configuration. Supports partial updates.

**Note**: Setting `isDefault: true` will automatically set other printers of the same type to `isDefault: false`.

**Permissions**: `update:PrinterSettings`
**Feature**: `printing.thermalPrinting`

Delete printer configuration.

**Note**: This removes the printer from `tenant.settings.printers` array.

**Permissions**: `delete:PrinterSettings`
**Feature**: `printing.thermalPrinting`

Test printer connection via TCP socket.

**Only for network printers**. Tests:
- TCP port connectivity
- ESC/POS protocol response
- Printer manufacturer detection
- Printer model detection

**Permissions**: `update:PrinterSettings`
**Feature**: `printing.thermalPrinting`

Get printer usage statistics.

**Returns**:
- Total printers count
- Active/inactive counts
- Count by printer type
- Count by connection type
- Total print jobs statistics

**Permissions**: `read:PrinterSettings`
**Feature**: `printing.thermalPrinting`

query.description: Specific IP or range to scan (e.g., 192.168.1.100 or 192.168.1.0/24). Leave empty for auto-detect.
Enable strict ESC/POS validation (default: true). Set to false to show all devices with open printer ports.

request.description:
Scan network for thermal printers.

**Auto-detect mode** (no ipRange): Scans all local network interfaces
**Manual mode** (with ipRange): Scans specific IP or CIDR range

**Strict Mode** (default: true):
- Only returns devices that respond to ESC/POS protocol
- Filters out virtual servers, web servers, etc.
- More accurate but slower

**Non-strict Mode** (strictMode: false):
- Returns all devices with open printer ports (9100, 515, 631)
- Faster but may include false positives

**Tested Ports**:
- 9100: Raw/JetDirect protocol
- 515: LPD (Line Printer Daemon)
- 631: IPP (Internet Printing Protocol)
- 80: HTTP (web interface)

**Permissions**: `create:PrinterSettings`
**Feature**: `printing.thermalPrinting`

**Note**: This can take 30-60 seconds for full network scan.

Quick scan for printers in common IP ranges.

**Scanned ranges**:
- x.x.x.100 - x.x.x.110
- x.x.x.200 - x.x.x.210
- x.x.x.250 - x.x.x.254

**Much faster** than full network scan (5-10 seconds vs 30-60 seconds).

Recommended for:
- Most office/gym networks
- Standard printer configurations
- Quick printer discovery

**Permissions**: `create:PrinterSettings`
**Feature**: `printing.thermalPrinting`
